arguments.snippet:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. BOIDENT3.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-ENTITY-TYPE PIC X.
       01 WS-OWN-PCT PIC 9(3)V99 VALUE ZERO.
       01 WS-CTRL-IND PIC X.
       01 WS-IS-BO PIC X(1) VALUE 'N'.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       1000-MAIN.
           ACCEPT WS-ENTITY-TYPE
           ACCEPT WS-OWN-PCT
           ACCEPT WS-CTRL-IND
           PERFORM 2000-CLASSIFY
           DISPLAY 'BO: ' WS-IS-BO
           STOP RUN.
       2000-CLASSIFY.
           EVALUATE WS-ENTITY-TYPE
             WHEN 'C'
               IF WS-OWN-PCT > 10.00
                  MOVE 'Y' TO WS-IS-BO
               END-IF
             WHEN 'P'
               IF WS-OWN-PCT >= 10.00 OR WS-CTRL-IND = 'Y'
                  MOVE 'Y' TO WS-IS-BO
               END-IF
             WHEN OTHER
               IF WS-OWN-PCT > 15.00 MOVE 'Y' TO WS-IS-BO END-IF
           END-EVALUATE.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. BOIDENT3.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-ENTITY-TYPE PIC X VALUE 'P'.
       01 WS-OWN-PCT PIC 9(3)V99 VALUE 10.00.
       01 WS-CTRL-IND PIC X VALUE 'N'.
       01 WS-IS-BO PIC X(1) VALUE 'N'.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       1000-MAIN.
           PERFORM 2000-CLASSIFY
           DISPLAY 'BO: ' WS-IS-BO
           STOP RUN.
       2000-CLASSIFY.
           EVALUATE WS-ENTITY-TYPE
             WHEN 'C'
               IF WS-OWN-PCT > 10.00
                  MOVE 'Y' TO WS-IS-BO
               END-IF
             WHEN 'P'
               IF WS-OWN-PCT >= 10.00 OR WS-CTRL-IND = 'Y'
                  MOVE 'Y' TO WS-IS-BO
               END-IF
             WHEN OTHER
               IF WS-OWN-PCT > 15.00 MOVE 'Y' TO WS-IS-BO END-IF
           END-EVALUATE.
